notes.title: Pulang Insanity - Director's Cut [Update 1.2.0.4a] & Future Projects
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=YiXFs64FK38;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Pulang Insanity - Director's Cut [Update 1.2.0.4a][/h2]

Update 1.2.0.4 is not officially released yet, 
but you can try all the improvements using this code :

[h1][b]pulangB3T4patches[/b][/h1] 

Properties Pulang insanity in your library -> BETAS -> Insert the code.

Full Devlog : [b][url=http://ozysoft.net/news/ozysoft-devlog-1-pulang-insanity-updates-future-projects-aug-2021/]HERE[/url][/b]

[h3]The Controller Support[/h3]
We are now adding controller support, It is not complete yet since sometimes some of the buttons in the UI are not selected automatically yet. gameplay-wise, it's working. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35317729/d4e0ffc2a7c6941138bc95ffa3904307638c4e18.jpg[/img]

if you started the journey entirely from the beginning using a gamepad only, you will find several problems including a hard time navigating through the Inventory. it happens because the game is entirely built using a PC/Keyboard in mind, we will continue to work on the next patch while also working on our second project, which was fortunately built with a lot of controller support from the very beginning.

[h3]Other updates[/h3]
This update also contains another fix such as a better enemy hitbox & more optimized code which I hope can at least can add a little bit of performance boost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35317729/25030a1ca69b17617fd7133ba6b0a166ca30e72a.png[/img]

the following is also a list of the improvements we made:

- Fix several enemies not Attacking bugs.
- Fix Enemy not stopped when reaching player.
- Fix several graphical glitches.
- Fix several performance glitches.
- Fix UI Glitches during gameplay (Cannot move sensitivity slider) 
- frame rate boost in most areas.
- Added partial Gamepad support.
- better hitboxes to increase the chance of hitting enemies
- enemy counts increased in some areas.
- unlocked Chinese localization.

[h2]Consideration[/h2]
[h3]The Draggable door Mechanics[/h3]
We also consider getting rid of the terrible door and drawer mechanism if you feel really like it. (maybe adding option to turn it off or some short)

Read about our next projects : [b][url=http://ozysoft.net/project-buramato/]HERE[/url][/b]

Please report your founded bugs to us!

notes.title: Notable things about upgrading to Director's Cut
notes.content:
[h2]NOTE: As for now, the Chinese version still in the works. the Director's Cut will only be playable in English, Korean, and Bahasa.[/h2]

there are several things to note if you upgraded from post 1.0.0.8 to 1.2.0.0 (Director's Cut)

[olist]
[*] If you already finished the game before, but the Chapter Selection still empty. just Press "Continue" and the chapters will be unlocked to the last level you played. BUT if it does not work and you lost your saves completely. you can ask us directly. [url=https://discord.gg/N6aTQfQMDA]Discord these days is the fastest way to reach us.[/url]
[*] You supposed to have at least one Weapon on The Final level, so if you updated from the earlier version to Director's Cut and then jump to the last chapter. you cannot progress at all. the only way to do this is go back to the very first chapter. grab a Knife on the first Otherworld and come back to the last chapter you played. 
[*] there are several levels you can pick a weapon. in The Nightmare, Kuyang, and Nissa.
[/olist]

we just got a lot of reports on this. we will fix it as soon as possible
as far as we know. you will not encounter any trouble if you freshly start the new game. 

Thank you very much and stay tuned. 

- Ozysoft

notes.title: [FREE UPGRADE] PULANG INSANITY - DIRECTOR'S CUT
notes.content:
[h2]NOTE: As for now, the Chinese version still in the works. the Director's Cut will only be playable in English, Korean, and Bahasa.[/h2]

[h2][b][url=http://ozysoft.net/news/pulang-insanity-directors-cut-rele/]RELEASE : PULANG INSANITY DIRECTOR'S CUT[/url][/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=S57_mjBQ1-c;full][/previewyoutube]

[i][Updates expected to be available on Jan 16, 2021.  | 10:00 PST][/i]

It doesn't feel like it has been about 9 months since the release of Pulang Insanity, there are many joys and sorrows that we felt when the game was still in the development stage. When Pulang Insanity released on the market, we were forced to cut some content at the last minute. It was a difficult decision but at that time we had no other choice.

However, after several months since its release, we finally decided to restore most of the content that had been cut. in the form of a Free upgrade which you will be able to enjoy in a moment.

Director's Cut version is a free upgrade to everyone who bought Pulang: Insanity. 
it will include additional new content in the form of a longer campaign, new levels, gameplay tweaks, more Enemy varieties, additional puzzles, challenges, Behind the Scene content, unlockables, and even more Secrets to uncover.
 
It will also come with a fix to most of the reported bugs & glitches in the vanilla version. 
Thank you for all of your support from the very beginning!

Pulang insanity is our first work. We are aware that there are still many flaws in this game but we are still trying to give our best.

The process of developing Pulang Insanity from the very start until now is a valuable lesson we will never forget! An extraordinary adventure.

Hearing every response that comes to Pulang Insanity, we are encouraged to make something better.
A big thank you to those of you who have supported Pulang Insanity. I present to you Pulang Insanity - Director's Cut which contains nearly all of the missing content.

Enjoy the definitive experience of Pulang Insanity!
See you at our next work.

Ozy | Founder of Ozysoft – Game Director of Pulang Insanity 

The Digital Comics - Victims will be delivered to your game directory on Jan 20, 2021.
It only will be available in English & Bahasa Indonesia.

notes.content:
Hello, thanks for all of your support in the development of this game. 
we finally able to updated Pulang: Insanity to version 1.0.0.4 that contains fixes on several known bugs that reported can breaking the progression or even the immersion;

there will be more updates coming soon.

We hope you all can enjoy Pulang: Insanity. :D

Thank You

Due to the mass spread of COVID-19 especially in Indonesia,

now COVID-19 has reached areas outside the capital of Indonesia. the government has also recently announced a policy to reduce the outbreak with the social distancing and work from home policies as well that everyone must always stay at home.

please know that we keep working as fast as we can to continue the progress and keep updating the main game.

with heavy heart, We deeply apologize to all fans & ask for your understanding as this decision was made for the sake of everyone's safety.

Best wish for all of you and your families, may you all always be safe during this really difficult time.

-Ozysoft Team
